newsitem.title: USA: Dollar General revises date of stock split.
newsitem.headline: Dollar General revises date of stock split.

text.p: Dollar General Corp said Wednesday it will distribute new shares as part of a five-for-four stock split at an earlier date than it had orginally planned.
The company said it will give out the shares on February 12 rather than February 17.
Its board of directors approved the split on January 13 for shareholders of record as of February 3.
Dollar General is a chain of more than 2,691 neighborhood stores operating in 24 states, with distribution centers in Kentucky, Georgia and Oklahoma.
